name: fx
description_en: Micro-blog tool offering built-in syntax highlighting, mobile publishing and more (alternative to Twitter, Bluesky). `MIT` `Docker`
description: An efficient (micro)blogging service that you can self-host
readme_preview:
A Twitter/Bluesky-like (micro)blogging service that you can self-host.

- 🚀 Low costs due to small footprint (only a few MB of memory are required). - 📝 Write posts in Markdown. - 🖥 Built-in syntax highlighting. - ∑ Built-in display for math expressions (LaTeX syntax, e.g. `$E=mc^2$`). - 📱 Publish and edit from desktop or mobile device. - 📁 Upload files and images to embed them in posts. - 🔒 Automatically backup to plain text files, see [Backup](#backup). - 🔭 Follow RSS feeds.

There is a demo...
